title: Model catalogue
description: The models of the stack, one entry per model with a block per AI_ENGINE that serves it; the CLI validates the same shape in packages/cli/src/schemas/models.ts, see ../../SPEC.md

id.description: The AI_MODELS value and the DNS label of the model's docker names (`<engine>-<id>`: Tilt resource, compose project, container, hostname), e.g. qwen3-5-0-8b

label.description: The model name shown by `models select`, e.g. Qwen3.5 0.8B

memory.description: The approximate memory in GB for weights and context, shown by `models select` as `~6 GB RAM` (VRAM on a gpu runtime)

note.description: A short hint shown by `models select` after the memory, e.g. what the model needs on a runtime

runtimes.description: The AI_RUNTIME values the engine runs the model on, every runtime when omitted

model.description: The ollama tag pulled on start, e.g. qwen3.5:0.8b
The Hugging Face model id, e.g. Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B

args.description: Model specific `vllm serve` arguments (context length, tool-call and reasoning parsers); runtime specific ones live in the compose file
